info.title: StellarEduPay API
info.description: Decentralized school fee payment system built on Stellar. This document is the single source of truth for the HTTP contract: CI fails when a router exposes a route that is missing here, or when the frontend or docs reference a path that is not listed.

SchoolIdHeader.name: X-School-ID
SchoolIdHeader.description: Tenant context (opaque schoolId, e.g. "SCH-3F2A"). One of X-School-ID or X-School-Slug is required.

SchoolSlugHeader.name: X-School-Slug
SchoolSlugHeader.description: Tenant context (school slug, e.g. "lincoln-high"). Alternative to X-School-ID.

SchoolContextRequired.description: Missing or unknown school context (X-School-ID / X-School-Slug).

Forbidden.description: Authenticated, but the token lacks the required role or tenant.

get.summary: Verify a payment receipt by receipt ID
get.description: Confirms that a printed or emailed receipt is genuine. Returns a minimal authenticity result only. Distinct from GET /api/payments/verify/{txHash} so that receipt IDs are not shadowed by the transaction-hash route.

parameters.name: receiptId
parameters.description: Receipt identifier embedded in the receipt QR code

get.summary: Verify a payment by transaction hash
get.description: Verifies a Stellar transaction hash. The hash must be a 64-character hex string; other values are rejected with 400. Receipt verification lives at GET /api/payments/receipts/{receiptId}/verify.
